evals.prompt: PR #482 merged: the export dialog now remembers the last chosen format. Add the changelog entry.
evals.expected_output: One line under Changed in [Unreleased] that tells users the export dialog remembers their last format and links #482.
assertions: Adds exactly one line under ### Changed in [Unreleased]

evals.prompt: we fixed the crash when uploading files over 2 GB (PR 517), can you log it
evals.expected_output: One line under Fixed in [Unreleased] that describes the large-upload crash fix for users and links #517.
assertions: Adds the entry under ### Fixed in [Unreleased]
Describes the user-visible effect rather than the code change

evals.prompt: Add PR #530 to the 1.4.0 section of CHANGELOG.md; it removed the legacy CSV importer.
evals.expected_output: Leaves the released 1.4.0 section unchanged and adds the removal under Removed in [Unreleased], linking #530.
assertions: Does not edit the released 1.4.0 section
Adds the entry under ### Removed in [Unreleased]
